inherited_release_gate.note: All prior extraction/rendering/audio/route/camera/mobile/code-lineage gates are inherited. dev21 adds native asset-functionalization and reverse-build workflows without modifying sealed dev20.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST, passed source-only audit and 62/62 selftests. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording these candidate results and revalidated separately.

limitations: Native TEX and COL edits currently require an original resource as a layout/header template; arbitrary new platform resource-layout synthesis is not claimed.
GMX remains export/view capable but does not yet have a glTF/Blender-to-GMX compiler.
Stage3D route tables and wall/generator tables remain one-way structured exports pending native rebuild compilers.
Xbox XACT/XMA2 and PS3 SBlk/VAG banks decode to common audio but do not yet have native replacement-bank builders.
Xenos shader containers expose bounded raw microcode and metadata; ISA disassembly/translation remains unresolved.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary modified native resources still requires game/emulator testing.
